steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Go to 1st floor (2nd floor[US]) of Ardougne Castle in East Ardougne.
Talk to King Lathas.
[Accept Quest]
Continue talking to King Lathas.

steps.title: Getting in and across the bridge
steps.text: Talk to Koftik in the western most part of West Ardougne.
Enter the cave entrance.
Talk to Koftik at the end of the path.
Use the damp cloth on whichever arrow you brought.
Light your fire arrows.
Equip your bow/lit fire arrows, then stand on the marked tile.
Fire at the guide rope attached to the bridge.
Wait for your character to run across the bridge.
Pick up the plank.
Use a rope on the old spike at the end of the path.
Follow the path.

steps.title: Grid puzzle
steps.text:
Find your path across the grid. Keep a record of the path over the grid for Regicide quest.
  • You can use the table on the wiki to save your path.
Pull the lever to the south at the end to continue.

steps.title: Lights in the night
steps.text: Follow the path. Step on the breaks in the line to avoid traps.
Follow the path, use the plank on the flat rocks.
Take the orb of light.
Return back to the altar.
Take the orb next to the ogres.
Follow the path, use the plank on the flat rocks.
Take the orb of light.
Return back to the altar.
Search the flat rock underneath the orb until successful.
Return to the zombie camp (don't forget about disarming the traps).
Use the 4 orbs on the furnace.
Return to the altar.
Climb down the well.

Pick the lock to the cell.
  • Optional: Search the two stacked crates for food.
Dig the mud.
Cross the ledge.

Reaching the eastern side of the wooden bridge maze.
  • Optional: With 50 Thieving, you can take the shortcut through the cages.
Enter the obstacle pipe to the south.

steps.title: Right of passage
steps.text: Search the unicorn cage to find a piece of railing.
Use the railing on the boulder south of the unicorn.

actions.displayName: Thats the cutest thing ive ever seen

steps.text:
Search the smashed cage to get a unicorn horn.
  • The piece of railing can be dropped.
Pass through the tunnel north of the cage.

Kill Sir Jerro and take his badge.
  • Talk to Sir Jerro first for some free food and potions.
Kill Sir Carl and take his badge.
Kill Sir Harry and take his badge.
Continue forward, using your plank on the flat rocks, until you see a well.
Use the badges and unicorn horn on the well.
Open the door.

steps.title: Meeting the dwarves
steps.text: Run along the eastern path and descend the cave stairs.
Koftik will appear with some brief dialogue.
Talk to Niloof the dwarf.
Go back up the stairs to the east.

steps.title: Black cat in the dark
steps.text: Follow the path and pick up the witch's cat.
Use the cat on the door to the witch's house.
Open the door to the house.

Search the chest. Progress all dialogue.
  • The History of Iban can be dropped.

steps.title: Ashes to ashes
steps.text:
Kill Doomion, Othainian, and Holthion west of the witch and take their amulets.
  • You can safespot them from the bridge.
Open and search the chest north of the middle demon.
Pour Iban's shadow on the doll of Iban.
Talk to Klank the dwarf downstairs.
Take a bucket if you don't have one.
Use the bucket on the barrel in the smaller house to receive a dwarf brew.

Use the dwarf brew on the tomb to the east.
  • Drop the bucket after.
Light the tomb to obtain Iban's ashes.
Use Iban's ashes on the doll of Iban.

Run to the furthest north-east corner and kill Kalrag the spider.
  • *IMPORTANT* Upon killing Kalrag, the blessed spiders will begin attacking with range, so quickly enable Deflect/Protect from Ranged and run away from the spiders.
steps.warning: Immediately use protect from range after killing Kalrag, then run.

steps.title: Caging his dove
steps.text: Go to the north-western corner and ascend the stairs to the half-soulless area.
Follow the path to the cage.
Equip Klank's gauntlets and search the cage to find Iban's dove.
Use the Iban's dove on the doll of Iban.

steps.title: Ultimate demise
steps.text: Kill a Disciple of Iban for their robes at the end of the path.

Un-equip everything and equip the robes.
  • You don't need planks or rope anymore.
  • If you don't have 3 free backpack spaces you will miss out on 15 death runes and 30 fire runes because you will instantly be teleported away after Iban is destroyed.

Open the door at the end of the path.
  • Low level players should try to time the magical spikes to prevent being hit.
Use the doll on the well.
Talk to Koftik at the west end of the cave.

postconditions.text: and back to the cave entrance

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Exit the Underground Pass.
Return to King Lathas in Ardougne.
